Is there an app to discuss books with other readers?

3 min read · Updated: 23 November 2026

Which kind of discussion fits you, in two minutes.

Short answer

Yes. Reading communities let you review books and join groups, and some book summary apps have discussion built in: Shortform has community discussions on its guides, and Zehn has a Book Club tab where you join topic clubs, post your take on a book and reply to others. A small book club still gives the deepest conversations.

TL;DR
  • Reading communities: reviews and groups around full books.
  • Summary apps with discussion: Shortform (community discussions), Zehn (Book Club tab).
  • A small book club gives the deepest talks.

Three ways to discuss books

OptionBest for
Reading community apps and websitesReviews, ratings and large groups around full books
Summary apps with discussionBusy readers who want to talk about ideas after a 15-minute summary
Your own book club, in person or onlineDeeper, regular conversations with people you know

How does the Zehn Book Club work?

In the Zehn app, the Book Club tab has topic clubs, such as Calm Club in Mindfulness & Happiness. Each club has a description, rules, a “What's on your mind today?” box and Posts and Challenges tabs. You post like a short social post and others reply in the comments. Details on our Zehn Book Club page.

Starting your own club

If you'd rather talk face to face or on video, our guide on how to start a book club covers size, rules and the first meeting, and our discussion questions work for any book.

Questions people ask

Can I discuss a book if I only read the summary?

Yes, especially for nonfiction, where the discussion is usually about ideas and how to apply them. Say that you read the summary so others know. Many busy readers join discussions after a 15 to 20 minute summary and read the full book later if the conversation hooks them.

Is the Zehn Book Club free?

The Book Club is a tab inside the Zehn app, which has a free plan with one book summary a day. Check the app for current access to posting and challenges. The paid Zehn Pro plan adds unlimited books, offline listening and the AI features.
